title: Cost Analyst
description:
Accountivity is hiring!

Job Title: Cost Analyst
Location: Toronto, ON
Job Type: Permanent
Salary: $75,000-$80,000/year

Our client in Toronto, ON is actively looking for a Cost Analyst to join their team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional to play a key role in costing analysis, internal controls, and financial reporting in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
 

Position Responsibilities:
  • Create item master and affiliated records for new molded and printed inventory items
  • Develop routings to allocate labour and overhead costs to inventory items
  • Ensure purchased items are costed accurately
  • Revalue actual inventory costs monthly based on resin pricing
  • Maintain records of PCNs for changes in tool master, routings, and inventory items
  • Prepare weekly reporting of Flash results and customer volumes, including labour and overhead spending with managers/supervisors
  • Participate in month-end financial close within agreed timelines for inventory/cost issues
  • Support year-end audit processes
  • Analyze material variances, freight, and pallet costs monthly
  • Assist with financial budget preparation for the Toronto facility
  • Administer bills of material, routings, and costed BOMs
  • Administer daily cycle count adjustments
  • Assist and later lead the annual physical inventory, including planning, execution, and variance analysis for finished goods, raw materials, and WIP
  • Lead, facilitate, or participate in CI projects
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement
Skills & Qualifications:
  • University degree in Accounting (CPA designation an asset)
  • 3–5 years of cost analysis experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Strong computer skills with intermediate/advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience in an MRP environment
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing is an asset
  • Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong competencies in customer focus, results orientation, impact & influence, critical information seeking, and business acumen

If you meet the above qualifications, please submit your resume. Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Accountivity is hiring!

Job Title: Payroll Administrator
Location: Toronto, ON
Job Type: Temporary to Permanent
Salary: $25.00-$27.00/hour

Our client in Toronto, ON is actively looking for a Payroll Administrator to join their team.

Position Description:
  • Responsible for processing the bi-weekly payroll of 700 individuals, both salaried and hourly across multiple Canadian provinces (ON, BC, SK and QC)
  • Process payroll updates including new hires, terminations, pay rate changes, etc.
  • Meet strict deadlines and ensure employees are paid accurately.
  • Issue ROE's when required and handle related requests from Service Canada
  • Submit Statistics Canada Reports
  • Respond to inquiries from employees regarding payroll policies and procedures and research specific areas of concern.
  • Prepare Management reports, when requested.
  • Maintain employee files.
  • Ensure accuracy of vacation accruals, garnishees, etc.
  • Administer the Benefits plan.
  • Obtain new employee backchecks (criminal, credit).
  • Post available positions on various employment websites.
  • Keep current with legislation and employment law, and have knowledge of both in ON, BC, SK and QC.
  • Maintain confidentiality at all times.
Required:
  • 3-5+ years of experience in a full cycle Payroll processing role
  • Experience will multi-provincial payroll including: ON, BC, SK and QC
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Able to do basic math.
  • Excellent organization, time management and multi-tasking skills.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Windows including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Able to deal with confidential issues professionally and with the utmost discretion.
  • CPM/PCP designation an asset
  • Experience with ADP/Workforce Now an asset

If you meet the above qualifications, please submit your resume. Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted.

title: Quality Lab Technician
description:
Mier Temporary Staffing is hiring!

Job Title: Quality Lab Technician
Location: Peel Region, ON
Job Type: Temporary
Salary: $21.00-$24.00/hour

Our client in Peel Region, ON is actively looking for Quality Lab Technician to join their team ASAP!

Roles and Responsibilities:
Quality
  • Perform testing and inspection for PET and PE products, including raw materials, in-process, and finished goods.
  • Prepare test samples and generate internal/external test reports and certificates.
  • Use various inspection tools (e.g., Vernier calipers, micrometers, plug gauges, tensile testers).
  • Maintain and calibrate lab equipment; ensure accuracy of measurement systems (Gage R&R / MSA).
  • Create and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and training documents for lab processes.
  • Analyze quality data using Excel and Minitab; support internal audits and quality assurance activities.
WAM (World Class Manufacturing)
  • Participate in WAM training and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Health & Safety
  • Promote and maintain high safety and environmental standards in all operations.
Requirements:
  • College diploma or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering field.
  • Experience in a manufacturing quality environment; knowledge of inspection tools and quality systems.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; experience with Minitab and SAP is an asset.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, or similar continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
  • Basic math skills and understanding of both metric and imperial measurement systems.


If you meet the above qualifications, and possess the above qualities, please send your resume and cover letter to careers@mier.ca, quoting job title Quality Lab Technician in the subject line.

Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted

title: Junior Payroll Administrator
description:
Accountivity is hiring!

Job Title: Junior Payroll Administrator
Location: Peel Region, ON
Job Type: 13 Month Contract
Salary: $24.00-$26.00/hour

Our client in Peel Region, ON is actively looking for a Junior Payroll Administrator to join their team.


Job Description:
  • Manage and maintain the Workflow Request Queue in SuccessFactors Employee Central for assigned Payroll Area
  • Process a weekly payroll for approx. 1000 union and non-unionized hourly employees
  • Ensure compliance with Federal & Provincial Payroll legislation and company policies
  • Process payroll adjustments, including bonuses, deductions, allowances etc. as required
  • Run payroll departmental reports as required
  • Print and distribute pay statements and/or cheques on a weekly basis
  • Assist in the processing of record of employments on a weekly basis
  • Maintain employee records as per government regulations
  • Monitor and address employee inquiries from the Payroll Support Helpdesk
  • Liaison with branches on payroll related items
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive payroll information
  • Assist with other payroll-related duties as assigned
Qualifications:
  • Minimum 1 years of experience in Processing Payroll
  • Minimum 1 years of SAP Success Factors experience preferred
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office/Excel/Outlook
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Accuracy and attention to detail a must
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • CPA Certification an asset
If you meet the above qualifications, please submit your resume. Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted.
